theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (f : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N) ((n : ℤ) + 2)) (F : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n (fun τ => f τ) F → ∀ σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, ∃ A : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n), ∀ (x : ℝ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => MvPolynomial.coeff d (F (σ • UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I))).val) Filter.atTop (nhds (MvPolynomial.coeff d A.val))
